candidates.title: Built a small client-side tool to auto-repair dirty JSON and strip invisible zero-width spaces
candidates.body:
Hey everyone,

I was dealing with a nasty bug last week where an API payload was failing to parse because of an invisible zero-width space (\u200B) copied over from Notion.

I put together a quick zero-telemetry utility to handle these silently failing edge cases: stripping invisible unicode, normalizing smart typographic quotes into standard code quotes, auto-repairing unquoted keys/trailing commas, and converting bidirectionally between JSON, YAML, XML, and CSV.

Everything executes locally in client memory so no sensitive payloads or tokens get sent anywhere.

Open source repository: https://github.com/alicoban2006-alt/data-sanitizer

(Live web app demo is pinned right at the top of the README for anyone who wants to try it directly). Would love feedback on any strange encoding edge-cases you run into!

candidates.title: Fixing the 'silent copy-paste bug': stripped invisible Unicode & smart quotes client-side
candidates.body:
Hey r/Frontend,

How many times have you or someone on your team pasted a snippet from Slack or Notion and had JSON.parse() blow up on an invisible zero-width space or curly quotes?

I ended up building an in-browser tool with Next.js and Tailwind to sanitize and convert payloads locally with zero server overhead.

Source code & live demo link in repo: https://github.com/alicoban2006-alt/data-sanitizer

Curious what regex patterns or format converters you guys find most reliable when dealing with untrusted user input.

candidates.title: DataPurge: In-browser JSON repair & text sanitizer with zero telemetry. Roast the utility.
candidates.body:
Hey all,

Most online formatters either bombard you with ads or transmit your secret API keys to remote servers.

I built DataPurge — a client-side tool that auto-repairs malformed JSON (missing quotes, Python booleans), removes hidden unicode from Slack/Notion, and converts between JSON/YAML/XML/CSV in real-time.

Repo + Live App: https://github.com/alicoban2006-alt/data-sanitizer

Roast the usefulness, the UI, or tell me why existing developer extensions already make this obsolete.

candidates.title: DataPurge – Looking for beta testers on a zero-telemetry in-browser data sanitizer
candidates.body:
Hi everyone,

Looking for developers to test edge-cases on DataPurge, an open-source utility that cleans dirty JSON, unescapes database logs, strips invisible zero-width spaces, and converts JSON/YAML/XML/CSV locally in browser memory.

GitHub repo & live web app: https://github.com/alicoban2006-alt/data-sanitizer

Appreciate any feedback on performance or missing format converters!

candidates.title: A zero-telemetry in-browser tool to repair malformed JSON and clean dirty text
candidates.body:
Built a small utility to fix unquoted keys, trailing commas, and strip invisible zero-width unicode characters from Notion/Slack copy-pastes locally without sending any data over the wire.

Project repo & live app: https://github.com/alicoban2006-alt/data-sanitizer
